title: Signature: Approval rehearsal
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): before a human approves, the gateway runs a dry-run rehearsal showing exactly what would happen step by step. The approver sees the rehearsal output, not just a description, so approval is grounded in observed behavior rather than imagination. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers dry-run rehearsals shown before approval.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 3, 2: 5, 3: 8}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
rehearsal = ["step %d: ok" % i for i in range(1, N + 1)]
packet_steps = N
match = len(rehearsal) == packet_steps
print("rehearsal steps:", len(rehearsal), "| matches packet:", match)
print("approval allowed:", match)

title: Signature: Approval fatigue guard
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the gateway watches for rubber-stamping: batches of similar requests approved in seconds get flagged, and the approver is shown a fatigue warning with the batch summary. Genuine review takes time, and the system defends that time. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers detecting rapid-fire approvals of similar requests.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: [2, 3, 2], 2: [1, 1, 2, 1], 3: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]}
gaps = CFG[LEVEL]  # seconds between approvals
avg_gap = sum(gaps) / len(gaps)
fatigue = avg_gap < 3 and len(gaps) >= 3
print("approval gaps (s):", gaps, "| avg: %.1f" % avg_gap, "| fatigue flagged:", fatigue)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
